verdict.rationale: IDSync is explicitly documented as mParticle's identity-resolution framework unifying known and anonymous identities across apps/platforms into a single customer profile, with dedicated docs on managing and configuring identity rules. This is corroborated by a broader identity-resolution/audience ecosystem (composable audiences, consent filters) referencing the unified profile. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of stitching accuracy and deeper detail on configurable rule mechanics beyond doc titles.
